race.description: XXXX Country Stampede Qualifier Open Hcp
race.comment: THIS IS ONE (5) is the one to beat after winning over 1200m at Dalby, where he defeated Koruto by over a length on soft ground. His previous Doomben CG BM78 run was too strong, but this country assignment suits him better, and with two wins from three starts here, his case is solid. GITALONG (2) has reliable sprint form, finishing fourth at Rockhampton after a slow start and second in a BM70 at Toowoomba previously. He's proven at this track and distance, posing a real threat. SHOWS A SIGN (7) lost by just a length at Kumbia as the favorite, and his Eagle Farm BM78 run looks decent in this field. He's suited to the distance, and Les Tilley's record on him is beneficial. BORN FEARLESS (9) can play a role.
